question: In which year was the first ever version of Microsoft Word - Word 1.0 launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Microsoft Word is a word-processor software launched by the Microsoft Corporation in **1983**__.
 
• **Word 1.0** was the first Word version of Microsoft Word.
 
• It was released for Xenix and MS-DOS in** October 1983.**
 
• Microsoft Word was developed by **Richard Brodie and Charles Simonyi.**
 
• Word 2.0 was released in** 1985.**
 
 
• Word 2.0 included spell-check and word-count options.
 
 
 
• Two years before WordPerfect for Windows, Microsoft published the first version of Word for the Windows OS in 1989.
 
• In 1985 Microsoft released **Macintosh Word 1.0.**
